'''''Piadina''''' (plural: ''piadine'') is an Italian flatbread.

==Ingredients==
* 12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] table [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¾ tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder (optional)]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]
* ½–¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] water

==Procedure==
# Pulse the flour, baking powder, and salt in a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]] until blended.
# Add the oil and pulse a few times to blend.
# Start the processor and add the water a little at a time until the [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] comes together.
# Remove the dough to a well floured counter top and [[Cookbook:Kneading|knead]] a few times, shaping it into a round ball and adding flour as needed.
# Divide the dough into four pieces and form each into a tight ball. 
# Cover all with some [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|plastic wrap]] and let rest for 30 minutes.
# After the rest period, roll each piece into a 9 inch round.
# Heat a dry 10-inch [[Cookbook:Cast Iron|cast iron]] [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] until a drop of water sizzles and evaporates.
# Dock (perforate) one of the rounds with a fork to prevent the formation of bubbles.
# Cook the round in the dry pan until the bottom has a few brown spots, 1½–2 minutes. Keep the docking fork handy to knock down bubbles as they form.
# Flip the round and repeat the browning step as above.
# Remove to a warm plate and gently fold in half. Cover to keep warm.
# Repeat the last four steps with the other rounds.
# Fill each with the foods and condiments of your choice and enjoy.
